title: Finally: Manchester United announce marathon deal
desc:
England's Manchester United have announced the signing of Cameroon's Carlos Baleba from Brighton during the ongoing summer transfer window, after a marathon of lengthy negotiations.
The club confirmed through its official website that the deal was completed "subject to registration", in a step that paves the way for the midfielder to appear in Manchester United colours.
Baleba, 22, signed a contract with Manchester United running until June 2031, with an option allowing the club to extend the deal for an additional season.
Baleba is regarded as one of the standout midfielders in the Premier League of late, having firmly established himself with Brighton, for whom he made 31 Premier League appearances last season.
Manchester United noted in its statement that during the 2024-2025 season Baleba ranked sixth among Premier League midfielders in total tackles and interceptions, and also came fourth in the number of forward carries per 90 minutes.
Last season, the player was among the top 8% of Premier League players in total tackles and interceptions, and also placed among the top 1% of players in second-ball recoveries.
Baleba's performances helped Brighton secure a place qualifying for the UEFA Conference League.
The Cameroonian's arrival at Manchester United comes as part of efforts to strengthen the team's midfield, in the hope that he will prove a strong addition to the Red Devils' line-up during the new season.
